scaffold.README.md:
# text-toolkit

Small dependency-free text utilities. Each module under src/ has a test file under test/ that defines its contract.

cases.title: Security quality gate on changed DB/secret code
cases.prompt: I just changed the database access and the API-key handling in src/db.js. Run the security quality gate on it before I commit. Report findings only; do not edit any files.

cases.title: Conceptual question must stay inline
cases.prompt: What does `git rebase` do? Answer in two sentences.

cases.title: One-line explanation must stay inline
cases.prompt: Explain in one line what this function does: `const sum = xs => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)`

cases.title: Run tests, lint and typecheck
cases.prompt: Run this project's tests, lint and typecheck scripts and report what passes and what fails. Do not fix or edit anything.

cases.title: Pre-flight brief of an unfamiliar codebase
cases.prompt: I'm new to this codebase and about to make a cross-cutting change to how invoice tax is calculated. Before anything else, give me a pre-flight brief: which files are in scope, the key function signatures, and architecture notes. Read-only; don't change anything.

cases.title: Dead code / over-engineering review
cases.prompt: Do a ponytail review of src/utils.js: dead code, redundancy, unused exports and over-engineering, with confidence-tagged findings. Report only; no edits.

cases.title: Commit hygiene and branch-state review
cases.prompt: Review the commit hygiene and branch state of this repo: are the commit messages acceptable, what is uncommitted, and is anything risky about to be committed? Read-only; don't commit or change anything.

cases.title: Dockerfile review
cases.prompt: Review the Dockerfile for image size, build caching and container security problems. Report only; do not edit it.

cases.title: Lovable project UI review goes to lovable-specialist, not frontend-specialist
cases.prompt: Review src/pages/Index.tsx in this project for UI and accessibility problems and suggest component-level fixes. Report only; no edits.

cases.title: Cloudflare Worker API review
cases.prompt: Review the API route in this Cloudflare Worker for input validation and error-handling problems. Report only; no edits.

cases.title: Capacitor Android release readiness
cases.prompt: Review the Capacitor Android setup (Gradle config and AndroidManifest) for Play Store release readiness. Report only; no edits.

cases.title: n8n failed execution root cause
cases.prompt: The n8n workflow in workflows/order-alert.json failed in production; the execution record is in execution-error.json. Find the root cause. Report only; don't edit anything.

cases.title: New multi-file feature: plan mode first
cases.prompt: Add retry with exponential backoff to fetchJson in src/api.js and update all callers and their tests.

cases.title: One-word typo: no plan mode
cases.prompt: Fix the one-word typo 'recieve' in README.md.

cases.title: Conceptual question: no plan mode
cases.prompt: Conceptually, when is exponential backoff with jitter better than a fixed retry delay? Answer briefly; no code.

cases.title: Second-model review is handed to agy as a --review task
cases.prompt: I want an independent second-model review of src/db.js from an agy instance, run as a background task. Start it and tell me which command you ran. Do not edit any files.

cases.title: A one-line question must not be delegated to agy
cases.prompt: In one sentence, what does findUser in src/db.js do?

cases.title: An approved multi-file plan is implemented by a delegated worker
cases.prompt: This plan is already approved; implement it now. 1) In src/api.js, make fetchJson retry failed requests (HTTP 5xx or a thrown fetch error) up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff starting at 100 ms. 2) Add test/api.test.js covering: success on the first try, success after one 500, and an error after three 500s. 3) Fix the README typo 'recieve'.
